legacy.claim: The delayed-center toy scale \(A_1\sim2\times10^{-3}\) is roughly 50–100× below representative observed disk-lopsidedness scales
legacy.evidence: \(\beta_g\approx2\times10^{-3}\) from ~600 km/s; the cited review reports both a larger-sample characteristic scale near 0.1 and older thresholds near 0.2 ([Jog & Combes 2009 review](https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/level5/Sept09/Jog/Jog2.html), [arXiv:0811.1101](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0811.1101)). The Branch C ceiling is now known and sits at or below this toy scale ([Branch C](branch-c.md) § Walls)
